features.rationale: The text states that twelve hours of workshops take place, so dance classes are part of the event.
Workshops take place in two rooms, which means more than one dance room.

features.quote: A welcoming space for both new and experienced dancers
features.rationale: Stating that the space welcomes new dancers as well as experienced ones shows it is open to beginners.

features.quote: This event will continue with a closed party afterwards for ticket holders.
